clue.text: Part of church has line with underwear attached

parts.note: a vest is an undergarment worn under a shirt
RY, short for railway, is the usual crossword abbreviation for a line

explanation.surface: A church building seems to have a washing line with undies pegged on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A vestry is the room in a church where vestments are kept and clergy robe.

clue.text: Like the gut feelings of rivals perhaps split by the church

indicators.note: split by means the letters are parted to take another piece inside
perhaps hints that the letters can be rearranged another way

parts.note: CE, Church of England, stands for the church

explanation.surface: Rival factions divided by the church feel deep instinctive passions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges the six letters into VISRAL, and 'split by' opens that after its third letter for the church abbreviation; the surface's feuding rivals are a decoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Visceral describes instinctive feelings arising from the bowels, the gut.

clue.text: Points this paper raised covering Jews and Arabs

indicators.note: in a down entry raised means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the puzzle appears in The Times, so this paper is that newspaper
E and S are compass points

explanation.surface: The Times prints a piece about Middle Eastern peoples.
explanation.definitionFit: Semites are the peoples speaking Semitic languages, including Jews and Arabs.

clue.text: Working as journalist, call about figurative expression one's picked up

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round another

parts.note: to ring is to call on the phone

indicators.note: in a down entry picked up means lifted, read upwards and so reversed

parts.note: a trope is a figure of speech

explanation.surface: A reporter phones in about a metaphor someone has noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' reverses the figure of speech into EPORT, since in a down entry it reads upwards; 'about' wraps the telephone call round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Reporting means writing news, the work of a journalist.

clue.text: One who praises mature soldiers protecting army leader

indicators.note: the outer pieces protect, so they are wrapped round the next piece

parts.note: mature means grown-up, adult

indicators.note: a leader is the front letter of the word army

parts.note: OR, other ranks, is the usual abbreviation for soldiers

explanation.surface: Someone sings the praises of veteran troops guarding their commander.
explanation.definitionFit: An adulator is a flatterer, someone who heaps praise on another.

clue.text: Change gear for this trial run

definitions.text: Change gear for this trial run

parts.words: Change gear for this trial run
parts.note: changing gear suggests driving, but here gear is costume put on for a final run-through

explanation.surface: A driver practises gear changes on a test drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gear' means clothes, not a car's gears: actors change into costume for the last rehearsal.
explanation.definitionFit: A dress rehearsal is the final run-through of a play in full costume.

clue.text: A quarter of tongue

definitions.meaning: the ... Quarter is a district of Paris
a tongue is a language, such as the one of ancient Rome

explanation.surface: Twenty-five per cent of a tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: It names the Parisian Latin Quarter and is also the language of the Romans.

clue.text: Haircut in fashion, certainly

parts.note: ton is an old word for fashionable style
sure means certainly

explanation.surface: A trendy haircut, definitely.
explanation.walkthrough: TON is the crossword staple for fashion, from French bon ton.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonsure is the shaven crown of a monk, a kind of haircut.

clue.text: Rebuke for sailor

definitions.meaning: a scolding, from the verb rate, to berate
a non-commissioned sailor in the navy

explanation.surface: A ticking-off for a seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: A rating is both a scolding and an ordinary naval seaman.

clue.text: Game editor commends to readers

parts.note: an editor urging readers to heed the editorial, the leader column, names a children's game of copying

explanation.surface: An editor tells readers to heed the editorial column.
explanation.walkthrough: A newspaper editorial is called a leader; the children's game has everyone copying the one in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Follow-my-leader is a children's game in which all copy the actions of the leader.

clue.text: System used by army signallers?

parts.note: a signalling method using flags held in the arms; 'army' is read as 'using the arms'

explanation.surface: A question about how military signallers communicate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'army' is a pun: not military, but 'with arms', since the flag positions are made by the signaller's arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Semaphore is a code of flag positions held by outstretched arms.

clue.text: A belief, whichever way you look at it

indicators.text: whichever way you look at it
indicators.note: the word reads the same from either end, so either direction of reading gives it

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A conviction holds firm however one regards it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or doctrine held to be true.

clue.text: Learn most of the moves needed to hypnotise

indicators.note: moves signals that the letters are shifted about into a new order
most of a word is all but its final letter

explanation.surface: Picking up a hypnotist's routine requires learning most of the passes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of the' gives TH; 'moves' rearranges LEARN with TH.
explanation.definitionFit: To enthral is to captivate or spellbind, close to hypnotising someone.

clue.text: Painful result of a severe tanning

definitions.text: Painful result of a severe tanning

parts.words: Painful result of a severe tanning
parts.note: tanning reads as a thrashing, but it means browning in the sun's rays

explanation.surface: It sounds like the aftermath of a beating.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'tanning' is slang for a thrashing; here it is sun-tanning taken too far.
explanation.definitionFit: Overexposure to the sun leaves skin burned and sore.

clue.text: Very obvious outcome of wassail

indicators.note: the letters come plainly out of the word that follows, set inside it

explanation.surface: A merry drinking bout has a predictable consequence.
explanation.walkthrough: Assai is the musical term for 'very', as in allegro assai.
explanation.definitionFit: In musical directions, assai is Italian for very, intensifying a tempo marking.

clue.text: Fought with others and 'came in first

parts.note: the rest means the others
to lead is to be in front, so came in first gives led

explanation.surface: A competitor grappled with rivals and won.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrestle is to fight by grappling, so the past tense means fought.

clue.text: Cap connected with career in cricket

parts.note: a tip is the end cap of something, like a ferrule
and joins things, so connected with gives and
a run is a career, a course of progress

explanation.surface: A cap is linked to a long sporting career.
explanation.walkthrough: Tip and run is an informal cricket game where the batsman must run whenever the bat touches the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Tip-and-run is a form of the sport where batsmen must run on every hit.

clue.text: Relative in' splendid southern cricket side

parts.note: grand means splendid
the on side is the leg side of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A relative plays in a fine team from the south.
explanation.walkthrough: The on side, also called leg side, is the half of a cricket field behind the batsman's legs.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandson is a child's son, a family relative.

clue.text: Figure from -the gutter given to spouting

definitions.text: Figure from -the gutter given to spouting

parts.words: Figure from -the gutter given to spouting
parts.note: sounds like a ranting lowlife, but is a carved figure on a roof gutter that spouts rainwater

explanation.surface: A guttersnipe who never stops mouthing off.
explanation.walkthrough: Gargoyles are carved stone waterspouts that throw rain from a building's gutters.
explanation.definitionFit: A gargoyle is a grotesque carved spout draining rainwater from a roof.

clue.text: When parking, come to rest on this?

definitions.text: When parking, come to rest on this?

parts.note: as means when, as in as I left
P is the symbol for parking
to halt is to come to a stop

explanation.surface: Where a parked car stops.
explanation.definitionFit: Asphalt is the tarmac surface a car stops on when it parks.

clue.text: One in publicity setting the rate

indicators.note: in places the first named piece within the publicity letters

parts.note: PR, public relations, means publicity
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: A PR campaign hires someone to set the pace.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacer is a runner who sets the speed for others in a race.

clue.text: Exotic courses for rich king

indicators.note: exotic suggests something strange and foreign, so the letters are made unfamiliar

explanation.surface: Exotic dishes served to a wealthy monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Croesus was the fabulously wealthy king of Lydia.

clue.text: A jolly girl using a lot of craft

parts.note: a jolly is slang for a Royal Marine, RM
Ada is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A cheerful young woman uses many boats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jolly' is old slang for a Royal Marine.
explanation.definitionFit: An armada is a fleet, a large number of ships.

clue.text: Quick answer a mistake in English tripos

indicators.note: a mistake garbles the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone slips up in a Cambridge exam.
explanation.walkthrough: The tripos is the Cambridge University honours examination.
explanation.definitionFit: A riposte is a swift, sharp retort.

clue.text: Smart swindle

definitions.meaning: to smart is to feel a sharp pain

explanation.surface: A clever con.
explanation.definitionFit: A sting is both a smarting pain and a confidence trick.

clue.text: Criticise summary

definitions.meaning: a ... is a brief outline of the main points

explanation.surface: Belittle a précis.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means disparage; as a noun it is a quick summary.

clue.text: Italian with a degree backing a fiddler

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the run is read backwards

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a degree

explanation.surface: An Italian graduate supports a violinist.
explanation.walkthrough: An Amati is a violin made by the Cremona family of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: An Amati, a violin from the famous Cremona workshop, is a fiddle, loosely the thing that fiddles.

clue.text: A dotty guide to pronunciation

parts.note: dotty means crazy on the surface but literally made of dots, two over a vowel to show it is said separately

explanation.surface: An eccentric manual on how to say words.
explanation.walkthrough: The mark is two dots over a vowel, as in naïve, showing it is sounded separately.
explanation.definitionFit: A diaeresis is the two-dot mark showing a vowel is pronounced on its own.

clue.text: Aircraft has to put in a universal banking system

indicators.note: put in means the first named piece is placed inside the others

parts.note: U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal
giro is a system of bank credit transfer

explanation.surface: An aeroplane must be fitted into a worldwide banking network.
explanation.definitionFit: An autogiro is an early rotorcraft with an unpowered rotor, an aircraft.

clue.text: Succeeded in joining concert

indicators.note: in means the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: a union is a joining together
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone made it into a concert.
explanation.definitionFit: Concert means agreement, as in acting in concert, which is the same as acting together in harmony.
